justificativa: The candidate adds a generic article registry (title, journal, year, Qualis, professor) with professor permissions. It misses the core of the 4N quadrennial evaluation: there is no quadrennial period, no relevance order unique per professor and period, no justification reasons, and no link between papers and program professors and students. It also uses an Article model instead of Paper, so it is unlikely to match what the official fix covers.
